description: Sunburst Chart by VisioChart The Sunburst Chart by VisioChart is a highly visual and engaging way to present hierarchical data in Power BI. Designed for simplicity and flexibility, this chart displays categories in a circular, radial layout that helps users easily understand how parts of a hierarchy contribute to the whole. With support for up to five levels of categories (dimensions), you can visually represent nested structures such as departments, product families, or geographical regions. The chart also allows for an optional measure to size each segment proportionally, making it easy to identify which categories dominate at any level. Unlike tree diagrams or traditional bar charts, the Sunburst Chart uses concentric rings to show hierarchy levels. The innermost ring represents the first dimension, with each outer ring displaying the next level in the hierarchy. This design provides a compact and elegant view of complex data structures without overwhelming the user.
